s: Debarim haasurim mishshum ohel beshabbat ubo k' seipim: asur laasot ohel, dehaynu gag hammaahil alayv lehagen meezeh dabar, kegon min hachamma o min haggeshamim o meezeh dabar acher, apillu hu aray sheeno asuy lehitqayyem, vaapillu en mechitztzot tachtayv, kegon sheppores machatzelet al gabbe arba qundesin, ap al pi ken kevan sheasuy kede lehaahil ulehagen — hare zeh ohel gamur, vaasaruhu chakamim ap al pi shehu aray, gezera mishshum ohel qeba shehu toledet boneh:

Velo aseru ella laasoto battechilla beshabbat, abal im haya ohel aray asuy mibbeod yom — muttar lehosip alayv beshabbat, kegon im hayeta hammachatzelet perusa mibbeod yom kede tepach, shezzehu shiur lihyot niqra ohel — muttar leporsah kullah lemachar ulehosip od machtzelaot, shehakkol eno ella tosepet leohel tepach heasuy meetmol. Vaapillu lipros al mechitztzot muttar beinyan zeh. Vetepach sheameru hu chutz min hakkerika, dehaynu shehammachatzelet kullah ap shehi keruka unetuna sham mibbeod yom, veyesh boobi iggul kerikatah kede tepach veyoter, ap al pi ken tzarik sheyyihyeh yotze mimmenna kede tepach parus leohel, mippene shessebib haiggul eno nireh keohel kelal:

Vekol zeh beohel shehu gag. Abal muttar laasot mechitztzot aray lekattechilla beshabbat, vaapillu oseh otah kede lehagen min hachamma o min hatztzinna — enah keohel bishbil kak. Veken im oseh otah bishbil hannerot shello yekabbeh otan haruach. Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar laasot mechitztzot litzniut bealma, shello yehe yosheb bemaqom megulleh, o kegon mechitztza sheosin bishat hadderasha lehapsiq ben anashim lenashim, vekol kayyotze bazeh. Uleolam en mechitztzat aray asura ella im ken oseh kede lehattir sukka, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tr"l, o lehattir tiltul, al derek sheyyitbaer besiman shs"b, o lehattir shear issur, kegon sheoseh mechitztza gaboah asara tepachim bipne hasseparim biprisat sadin o machatzelet kede sheyyehe muttar leshammesh mittato beoto cheder, o kede laasot sham tzerakayv — asur laasotah battechilla beshabbat, lepi shebbekol maqom shehammechitztza matteret — hi choleqet sham reshut bipne atzmah, kegon keshemmatteret issur tiltul hi osa oto maqom reshut hayyachid, vecholeqet oto mereshut harabbim o karmelit sheetzlo, veken becheder shebbo hasseparim, hi choleqet oto lishte reshuyyot, hasseparim hem birshut bipne atzmah, vehu meshammesh veoseh tzerakayv birshut bipne atzmah, vekevan shehu oseh otah kede shettachaloq reshut bipne atzmah — hare zeh keoseh ohel. Abal im eno tzarik lo shettechalleq reshut bipne atzmah — muttar laasotah battechilla beshabbat, ap im hi matteret issur. Kegon shettoleh mechitztza bipne or hanner kede sheyyihyeh muttar leshammesh mittato, sheeno tzarik kan lechilluq reshuyyot, ella kevan shehammechitztza hi gaboah mehanner beinyan sheeno roeh et hanner bemaqom shemmeshammesh, vegam hi aba qetzat beinyan sheen haor nireh yapeh derek hammechitztza — muttar leshammesh ap im enah gaboah asara tepachim sheenah choleqet reshut kelal, vegam im enah qeshura betob beinyan shello yukal haruach lehanid otah, kemo shetztzarik liqshor ken bimchitztzot haasuyot lechilluq reshuyyot, kegon bipne hasseparim, kemo shennitbaer besiman r"m, vekevan sheeno tzarik lo shettechalleq reshut bipne atzmah — muttar laasotah ap beinyan shecholeqet reshut, dehaynu shehi geboha asara tepachim uqeshura heteb:

Veken bisparim im toleh hammechitztza neged kol hasseparim sheen megullin kelal, sheeno tzarik kan lechilluq reshuyyot, im yesh mikseh echad al hasseparim lebad mimmechitztza zo, sheap im en mechitztza zo gaboah asara tepachim, vegam enah qeshura betob sheenah choleqet reshut kelal, mikkol maqom enah gerua mikkissuy bealma, umuttar laasot tzerakayv sham, o apillu leshammesh, im yesh mikseh echad al hasseparim lebad mimmechitztza zo, shehare yesh kan shene kissuyim, vahare zeh kikli betok keli. Lepikak, muttar litlotah beshabbat apillu beinyan shecholeqet reshut, kevan sheeno tzarik lo shettachaloq reshuyyot. Veen tzarik lomar shemuttar lekassot hasseparim bibgadim shene kissuyim, shehare en kan mechitztza kelal:

Vaapillu hasseparim megullim lemala mehammechitztza, sheen mechitztza zo chashuba kissuy, o sheen od kissuy al hasseparim verotzeh leshammesh, vetzarik shettehe hammechitztza gaboah asara tepachim uqeshura kehilkatah kede shettachaloq reshut bipne atzmah, veken bekol maqom sherotzeh laasot mechitztza lechalleq reshut — en issur ella laasotah battechilla beshabbat, abal im hayeta asuya mibbeod yom keshiur tepach — muttar lehosip aleha beshabbat, shettosepet ohel aray mutteret, ben shettepach zeh hu milmala lematta, kegon machatzelet hakkeruka al hammot mibbeod yom ukede tepach mimmenna meshulshal lematta mibbeod yom — muttar leshalshel kullah lematta beshabbat uleqoshrah kehilkatah, uben shettepach zeh hu min hatztzad, kegon im hayeta mechitztza boletet min hatztzad lipne hasseparim rochab tepach — muttar litlot sadin bipnehem beshabbat, shehassadin hu tosepet ohel aray. Veap shehammechitztza habboletet sham hi qebua — en bekak kelum, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"g, sheen issur ella keshehattosepet hi qebua:

Vekol zeh bimchitztzat aray, abal mechitztza qebua asura bekol inyan, apillu enah naaset ella litzniut bealma. Vaapillu lehosip aleha tosepet qabua asur bekol inyan. Umikkol maqom, muttar litlot beshabbat sedinim hamtzuyyarim lenoy, ap al pi sheqqebuin sham, kevan sheenan asuyin sham limchitztza:

Vehavvilon shettolin lipne happetach bimqom delet, ap al pi shehu taluy sham biqbiut — muttar litloto beshabbat. Shekkevan shehu na vanad beruach metzuya, vegam eno meakkeb leholekim veoberim veshabim derek sham — eno niqra mechitztza qebua ella mechitztzat aray, veen bah issur kesheenah asuya lehattir. Veken happaroket shellipne aron haqqodesh muttar litloto sham beshabbat mittaam zeh, apillu im en delet laaron vehapparoket hu mechitztza rebiit laaron, mippene shemmechitztzat aray hu veeno asuy ella litzniut. Ubilbad sheyyizzaher keshettoleh havvilon vekayyotze bo shello yikkapel lerochbo tepach beshaa shettoleh oto, shennimtza oseh ohel begag tepach. Lepikak, im hu vilon gadol — tolin oto shenayim, sheyyekolim litloto kullo keechad shello yitqappel, abal echad asur. Vekilla sheyyesh lah gag tapur vetaluy sebibah keen sapa — asur litlotah kelal beshabbat apillu baasara, shei epshar shello tigbah hassapa meat veteaseh ohel aray:

Etzim shettoqeim rosham haechad bedopen hassepina, vekopepin rosham hashsheni beiggul ad dopen hashsheni, uporesim alehem machtzelaot lehagen min hachamma o min haggeshamim, im yesh berochab haetzim tepach, apillu beechad mehem — muttar lipros alehem machtzelaot beshabbat, sheeno ella mosip al ohel aray heasuy mibbeod yom. Vaapilu en beshum echad mehem rochab tepach, im hem semukim zeh lazeh bepachot mishshelosha tepachim — hare hem chashubim ohel, shekkol pachot mishshelosha tepachim hu kelabud, umuttar lipros alehem machtzelaot beshabbat. Veken arisat hattinoq sheyyesh aleha chashuqim uporesin alehem sadin lehagen mippene hazzebubim, im hachashuqim hem bederek shennitbaer — muttar lipros alehem sadin beshabbat, veim lav — asur:

Kol gag aray sheeno mitkavven bo laasiyyat ohel sheyyaahil al mah shettachtayv, ella kede lehishtammesh bo ezeh tashmish begupo, kegon shemmesim dap hashshulchan al raglayv, ap al pi sheoseh bazeh gag aray — en bekak kelum, kevan sheeno mitkavven laasiyyat ohel. Umikkol maqom, im maamid gam mechitztzot aray tachat gag zeh — hare zeh domeh leohel, veasur laasoto kedarko millematta lemala, ella milmala lematta derek shinnuy. Kegon mitta sheharaglayim shellah hem dappim mechubbarim kedopne hatteba, uporesim alehem or o shemmannichim alehem qerashim milmala lishan alehem — lo yaamid et haraglayim battechilla veyanniach haor o haqqerashim alehem kedarko bechol, shehare zeh domeh laasiyyat ohel, ella yochez haor o haqqerashim techilla baavir veachar kak yasim haraglayim tachtehem, sheen zeh domeh laasiyyat ohel, sheen derek libnot milmala lematta:

Veim mitta zo en aleha or o qerashim, ella hi mesoreget bachabalim milmala, im yesh ben chebel lechebel shelosha tepachim, sheen kan labud — asur lipros aleha sadin battechilla beshabbat, o lehanniach aleha kar o keset, mippene shezzeh domeh laasiyyat ohel. Veken asur lesalleq beged hattachton shealeha, mippene shehu kesoter ohel. Veim haya aleha kar o keset o beged acher parus meereb shabbat keshiur tepach — muttar lipros beshabbat al kol hammitta, sheeno ella mosip al ohel aray:

Vekol zeh bemitta zo sheyyesh lah mechitztzot, dehaynu haraglayim shellah shehen kedopne hatteba, vaapillu en lah arba mechitztzot, ella shettayim zo keneged zo, abal mittot shellanu, sheen al raglehen torat mechitztzot — muttar lehaamidah techilla veachar kak lehanniach bah haqqerashim, o im hi mesoreget bachabalim — muttar lipros aleha sadin battechilla beshabbat ap im yesh ben chebel lechebel shelosha tepachim. Veen bazeh mishshum asiyyat ohel, mippene sheohel aray kazeh sheeno mitkavven bo laasiyyat ohel — lo asaruhu chakamim, ella im ken yesh lo tachtayv mechitztzot hammaggiot laaretz, sheaz hu domeh leohel. Veim hen maggiot bepachot mishshelosha tepachim samuk laaretz — yitbaer besiman tq"b:

Keshemmesadderin chabiyyot zo al zo achat al gabbe shettayim — ochez beyado haelyona visadder hattachtonot tachteha. Abal lo yesadder hattachtonot techilla veyanniach haelyona alehen, mippene shehechalal shennaaseh benehen domeh leohel, sheyyesh lo shette mechitztzot vegag, lepikak tzarik laasoto bederek shinnuy milmala lematta. Abal muttar lehanniach seper echad mikkan veechad mikkan veechad al gabbehen, ap shennaaseh benehen chalal tepach, shehoil veen tzarik kelal laavir shebbenehem — eno domeh leohel shemmishtammeshim bachalalo. Mah sheen ken bechabit — tzarik hu laavir shebbenehen shello yitappeshu hechabiyyot, shebbishbil kak hu mesadderam ken. Veken bammitta, ap im en lah ella shette mechitztzot zo keneged zo — yesh lo tzorek baavir shettachteha, shemmishtammesh sham bintinat sandalim vekayyotze bahem. Veen tzarik lomar im yesh lah arba mechitztzot kedopne hatteba, sheyyakol lehatznia sham chapatzayv kemo batteba:

Kol gag aray sheeno mitkavven bo laasiyyat ohel — lo aseru leporso al hammechitztzot shemmaamid tachtayv beshabbat, ella keshello haya haggag qabua bimchitztzot mibbeod yom, abal im haya kebar qabua bahen mibbeod yom, ella shehayu nikpalim umunnachim — muttar leposhtan ulehaamidan beshabbat. Kegon kisse heasuy peraqim, ukesherotzim lesheb alayv potechin oto vehaor niptach venimtach, ukeshemmesirin oto sogerin oto vehaor nikpal — muttar lepotcho lekattechilla beshabbat, ap im yesh lo mechitztzot tachtayv, mippene sheeno domeh laasiyyat ohel, kevan sheeno oseh kelum, shehare asuyim veomedim hem kebar haggag im hammechitztzot mibbeod yom, ella shemmotechan beshabbat lesheb alehem. Umittaam zeh muttar lehaamid hachuppa ulesalleqa, veken haddap haqqabua bakkotel shemmannichin alayv separim, ap im yesh lahen mechitztzot:

Meshammeret shettolin otah latet bah shemarim lesannenan umotechim piha lekol tzad — chashub asiyyat ohel, veasur lintotah ulemotchah im hayeta teluya im hashshemarim mibbeod yom. Veap al pi sheggag belo mechitztzot eno asur mishshum ohel — kan aseru, kede shello yaaseh kederek shehu oseh bechol, mishshum zilzul shabbat. Abal muttar litlotah ulemotchah kede litten bah perot o shear debarim, o apillu kede lesannen bah yayin umayim tzelulim, shemmuttar lesannenam beshabbat, veen kan zilzul shabbat kelal:

Ohel meshuppa, im yesh berosho gag rachab tepach beyosher, o apillu en berosho tepach ella yesh bepachot mishshelosha tepachim samuk lerosho rachab tepach, shekkol pachot mishshelosha tepachim hu kelabud, vahare zeh keillu yesh berosho gag rachab tepach — hare zeh ohel qabua, im hu asuy lehitqayyem, vehannoteh oto beshabbat — chayyab mishshum boneh, vehamporqo — chayyab mishshum soter, kemo soter binyan gamur. Abal im en berosho gag tepach, velo bepachot mishshelosha tepachim samuk lerosho rochab tepach — hare zeh ohel aray, vehaoseh oto battechilla beshabbat — patur, abal asur middibre soperim, ben lintoto ben leporqo, apillu eno asuy leqiyyum kelal:

Ketzad? Tallit kepula shekkopelin otah al hammot, dehaynu shechetzyah teluya al hammot mikkan vechetzyah mikkan, ushene qitzvoteha maggiin laaretz, veniknas veyashen sham batztzel ben shette qitzvoteha — asur litlotah battechilla beshabbat, ap al pi sheen lah gag tepach velo bepachot mishshelosha samuk leroshah rachab tepach. Veim hayeta keruka al hammot mibbeod yom, veyesh beqitzvoteha chutin teluyin shemmoshekin otah bahem al hammot leporsah lekan ulekan — muttar lemoshkah bahem beshabbat, mippene shechutin ellu kevan shehem teluyim bah mibbeod yom kede lemoshkah bahem leporsah — hare hem moilim kemo im hayeta perusa rachab tepach mibbeod yom, sheaz eno oseh beshabbat ella tosepet ohel aray. Umuttar gam ken leporqah meal hammot, shekkol ohel shemmuttar lintoto veen bo mishshum binyan — en bo gam ken mishshum setira umuttar leporqo, chutz mikkeshemmosip al ohel tepach heasuy mibbeod yom, sheeno muttar ella listor et hattosepet, abal lo et haohel heasuy meetmol. Veap al pi ken muttar kan lepareq hattallit meal hammot, mippene shekkan lo haya ohel tepach mammash mibbeod yom, ella shehachutin moilin kemo rochab tepach:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen lah gag tepach velo bepachot mishshelosha samuk leroshah rochab tepach, abal im yesh lah gag tepach, o bepachot mishshelosha samuk leroshah rochab tepach, shezzehu ohel qabua — en hachutin moilin kelum, sheapillu lehosip al ohel qeba asur. Veap im tallit zo en asuya lehitqayyem kan, sheddato leporqah, ap al pi ken, kevan shehi netuya kederek netiyyat ohel qabua — lo heqellu bah chakamim kelum, shemma yimmalek aleha shettehe qebua kak kemo shehi netuya, venimtza shehosip ohel qabua. Velo heqellu lehosip al ohel aray, ella keshehu beinyan sheen derek kelal leqobo kak kemo shehu natuy, kegon perisat machatzelet al gabbe qundesin o al hassepina kemo shennitbaer lemala, sheen derek kelal liqboa hammachatzelet sham kak kemo shehi perusa beshabbat. Veken kol kayyotze bazeh:

Killat chatanim sheen begaggah tepach velo bepachot mishshelosha samuk legaggah tepach, hoil vehi metuqqenet lekak — muttar lintotah umuttar leporqah beshabbat. Vehu shello tehe meshulshelet lematta min hammitta tepach, mippene shehakkilla asuya lehagen min hachamma o middabar acher, veyesh shem ohel aleha, ella sheen lah gag, vekevan shehi meshulshelet lematta min hammitta tepach — hare hammitta naaset gag laqqir tepach shessebib hammitta. Veap al pi shehammitta enah asuya lehagen, veen shem ohel aleha, mikkol maqom, kevan sheyyesh shem ohel al qir tepach zeh shehu mikkelal hakkilla haasuya lehagen — hare yesh kan ohel im gag. Abal mitta sheen aleha killa, ap al pi shehassadin happarus aleha yored mimmenna tepach lematta min hammitta mikkol tzedadeha — en bekak kelum, sheap shehammitta naaset gag leqir tepach zeh — hare en kan shem ohel kelal, lo al tepach zeh velo al hammitta. Umittaam zeh muttar lipros mappa al hashshulchan battechilla beshabbat, ap im hi yoredet lematta min hashshulchan tepach mikkol tzedadayv:

Beged sheshshotechin al pi hechabit lekassotah — lo yishtachennu al pene kulla, mishshum ohel, ella yanniach miqtzat piha megulla. Vehu shehechabit enah melea legamre, ella hi chasera tepach, sheaz kesheshshoteach habbeged al pene kulla — hare zeh keoseh ohel al chalal tepach. Abal im enah chasera tepach — en bah mishshum ohel, shekkol ohel sheen lo chalal tepach — eno qaruy ohel kelal. Abal kesheyyesh sham chalal tepach, ap al pi shemmechitztzot shel chalal zeh, dehaynu dopne hechabit, hayu kebar asuyot mibbeod yom, veim ken en leesor bahen mishshum ohel, shehare muttar lehanniach qedera al pi hakkira beshabbat kemo shennitbaer besiman rn"g, veen bah mishshum ohel al chalal hakkira, hoil vedopne hakkira asuyot veomedot kebar mibbeod yom, velo aseru gag aray sheeno mitkavven bo laasiyyat ohel ella keshemmaamid mechitztzot tachtayv beshabbat kemo shennitbaer lemala, vehakkissuy sheal pi hechabit gam ken eno mitkavven bo leohel ella lekissuy bealma — ap al pi ken eno domeh liqdera al gabbe kira, mippene sheppi hechabit shebbimehem haya rachab harbeh yoter mippi hakkira, ukeshemmekasseh kol piha — hare zeh domeh laasiyyat ohel, ap shehammechitztzot asuyot mibbeod yom. Vehu haddin sheasur littol hakkissuy hamkasseh kol piha im hi chasera tepach, mishshum sheddomeh lesoter ohel. Veeno domeh limgupa shemmuttar littelah ulehachazirah, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"d, lepi shehammegupa metuqqenet lekak, vetiqqunah mokiach aleha shehi omedet lekak, laken enah niret keohel, mah sheen ken keshemmekasseh bebeged, ap shehabbeged meyuchad lekak, mikkol maqom en bo tiqqun hammokiach alayv shehu omed lekak. Veken haddin bekissuy shear kelim harechabim beyoter, kerochab pi hechabiyyot shebbimehem:

Veyesh omerim shello aseru ken bechabit vekayyotze bah, ella begigit vekayyotze bah shehi rechaba yoter midday. Veyesh lehachamir kasbara harishona, vehammeqillin kasbara haacharona — en limchot beyadam, mippene sheyyesh omerim sheen bekissuy kelim mishshum ohel kelal ap bekelim harechabim yoter midday:
